name: TheraNest

lifecycle.notes: Rebranded from Therapy Brands to Ensora Health in April 2025

short_description: Cloud-based mental health EHR and practice management for therapists, counselors, and psychologists with scheduling, billing, telehealth, and documentation.
long_description: TheraNest is a cloud-based mental health EHR and practice management system designed for therapists, counselors, psychologists, and social workers. Originally launched in 2008 and now part of Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands), TheraNest serves both solo practitioners and group practices. The platform offers integrated scheduling with client reminders, HIPAA-compliant telehealth, customizable clinical documentation, insurance billing with electronic claims, credit card processing, and a secure client portal. TheraNest features an AI Session Assistant for telehealth note drafting and provides custom form builders for intake and assessments. In May 2021, private equity firm KKR acquired Therapy Brands for $1.25 billion, and in April 2025, the company rebranded to Ensora Health to reflect its broader platform vision.
one_liner: Mental health EHR and practice management trusted by over 200,000 providers.
best_for: Solo therapists and counselors looking for affordable, comprehensive EHR
Small to medium group practices needing integrated billing and scheduling
Mental health clinicians wanting per-therapist pricing flexibility
Practices seeking HIPAA-compliant telehealth with documentation tools
not_for: Addiction treatment centers needing specialized SUD features

pricing.notes: Three tiers: Essentials ($29/therapist/mo) includes scheduling, portal, EHR, credit card processing. Advanced ($59/therapist/mo) adds insurance billing, custom forms, 30 free claims/month. Premier ($89/therapist/mo) adds unlimited claims, billing automation, integrated telehealth. Annual AMA CPT license: $19.50/therapist. AI Session Assistant: $35/provider/month.

faqs.q: How much does TheraNest cost per month in 2026?
faqs.a: TheraNest offers three plans: Essentials at $29/therapist/month, Advanced at $59/therapist/month with insurance billing, and Premier at $89/therapist/month with unlimited claims and telehealth. AI Session Assistant is an additional $35/month per provider.

faqs.q: Is TheraNest part of Ensora Health?
faqs.a: Yes, TheraNest is the mental health EHR product from Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands). The company rebranded to Ensora Health in April 2025 after being acquired by KKR in 2021.
Yes, TheraNest includes HIPAA-compliant telehealth on the Premier plan ($89/therapist/month). Lower tier plans may have telehealth as an optional add-on.
TheraNest is ideal for solo therapists and small group practices looking for affordable, comprehensive practice management. Its per-therapist pricing makes it accessible for practices of all sizes.
